ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_FACTCARDSOUTSTANDINGBALANCE
AS
BEGIN

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,StatementBalanceCashAmount
,StatementBalance
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BPCS.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,BPCS.RetailStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,BPCS.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalanceCashAmount
,BPCS.RetailStatementBalanceAmount + BPCS.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalance
,BPCS.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
[BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary] BPCS
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BPCS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL

END
